collection.description: Musicians from different communities gather on a breezy hillside.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Musicians from different communities gather on a breezy hillside.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The melodies blend into a new tune.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The rhythms clash and the musicians laugh.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Each group enjoys hearing unfamiliar songs.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The afternoon runs late and several songs wait until next time.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: New musicians learn a simple rhythm.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The beginners prefer to clap along.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The listeners enjoy the music without pressure.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The wind grows loud and everyone moves downhill.
